title: The Pilgrims' Well
text: Every pilgrim on this road drops a coin into the well and makes a wish. The well is full to the brim, crusted with glinting silver and copper. Beneath the coins, if you look closely, the water still moves.

options.label: Drop a coin and wish, as every pilgrim has before you.

outcomes.text: Something lightens a little. The water stirs beneath the coins.

options.label: The Leader scoops up the coins; a fortune should not sit in a hole.

outcomes.text: Every wish comes up with the fortune. None of them were wishes for you.

options.label: The devout prays over the well, for all who wished here.
